sentences.en: And, as ever, History will do a reasonably thorough job of erasing the no-talent fools from popular consciousness.

sentences.en: Consider applying some of the MAC Pro eye makeup remover or Gently Off version to a cotton swab and gently erasing your makeup with small strokes rather than saturating a cotton ball and wiping the entire eye area.

sentences.en: Then, give your child dry-erase markers instead of crayons, and she can create all kinds of variations, erasing and adding as much as she wants.

sentences.en: I've selected the eraser tool (big circle in image, selected button on the tool bar) and am erasing around the Harry picture.

sentences.en: Whether it's foundation packed with sunscreen or an anti-stretch mark cream suddenly touted as the new wrinkle erasing miracle, there's simply no dearth of skin care products formulated to help us reclaim our lost youth.
sentences.vi: Cho dù đó là kem nền có chứa kem chống nắng hay kem chống rạn da đột nhiên được chào mời như một phép màu xóa nếp nhăn mới, đơn giản là không có sự thiếu hụt các sản phẩm chăm sóc da có công thức giúp chúng ta lấy lại tuổi thanh xuân đã mất.

sentences.en: There are ways of releasing you from Rhyn's claim, and there are ways of erasing your memory.
